purpose: Test whether a causally detected Hyperliquid repeated-child-order sequence predicts same-direction delivery to already-known external liquidity strongly enough to survive realistic cost stress and justify exact Bybit execution reconstruction.
trader_explanation: Three same-wallet, same-coin, same-side taker child orders spaced 20 to 40 seconds apart identify a likely active parent execution after the third child order completes.
The parent side fixes direction; ML may accept or reject continuation but may never reverse it.
The previous fully completed 15-minute high or low in the parent direction is the external-liquidity target.
The observed three-child-order origin extreme is structural invalidation.
Entry is the first Hyperliquid market trade at least two seconds after detection; target and stop are frozen before entry; no elapsed-time liquidation is used.

source_contract.read_validation_condition: 2025-08-05 and 2025-08-06 files remain unread until every confirmation gate passes.
prohibited: any official project 2024-2026 Bybit evaluation outcome

event_contract.eligible_fill: coin in BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP; crossed=true; recognized side; finite positive price and size; valid wallet, time and oid; liquidation-tagged fills excluded
event_contract.partial_fill_collapse: minimum fill time, notional-weighted VWAP, summed notional and majority non-empty cloid
event_contract.detection: third child order of a maximal consecutive same-side cadence run
event_contract.entry_proxy: first same-coin market-series trade at or after detection plus 2000ms, rejected when more than 5000ms late

structure_contract.external_range: high and low of the immediately preceding fully completed 15-minute UTC interval from retained same-coin market trades
structure_contract.long_stop: minimum VWAP of the first three child orders, buffered 2bp lower
structure_contract.short_stop: maximum VWAP of the first three child orders, buffered 2bp higher
structure_contract.eligibility: entry must lie strictly between target and stop and each structural distance must be finite, positive and no more than 300bp
structure_contract.exit: first market trade reaching target or stop; equal-timestamp ambiguity is stop-first; unresolved source boundary receives the full structural stop in account replay

model_contract.calibration: one IsotonicRegression fitted only on the calibration partition
model_contract.direction_lock: model can only accept or reject the detected parent-order side; it cannot reverse direction

account_contract.simultaneous_priority: higher expected value, then same_cloid_three, then BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, then event key
account_contract.top_winner_counterfactual: remove the largest positive 10 percent of 12bp event keys before slot arbitration and replay from initial NAV
account_contract.funding: not applied because every source window ends before 16:00 UTC and no position may survive its source boundary

promotion_boundary: A validation pass opens only a new exact Bybit BBO/depth/funding replay on the same 2025 events. This screen is not rank eligible and cannot open official 2024-2026 evaluation, risk/leverage search or orders.
